title: Mip-NeRF 360 room (all 311 original dataset photographs)
citation: Barron et al., Mip-NeRF 360: Unbounded Anti-Aliased Neural Radiance Fields, CVPR 2022.

license_evidence.grant_quote: Both datasets and checkpoints are released under CC-BY 4.0 license.

attribution_note: Credit the listed dataset authors, source project and CC BY 4.0; identify the room-only selection. Original dataset JPEG payloads are unchanged.

archive.whole_archive_verification: not_performed; only selected byte ranges downloaded

range_requests.purpose: source poses_bounds.npy and cameras.bin metadata, including intervening directory headers

archive.range_verification: HTTP 206, exact Content-Range, ETag/MD5, and x-goog-generation checked; ZIP local member names, decompressed lengths and CRC32 verified.

selection: All original room/images/DSCF4667.JPG through DSCF4977.JPG inclusive, sorted by filename. No images_2/_4/_8 variants or other scenes.
scene_scope: One real furnished living room. No measured metric dimensions are asserted.
image_modifications: None: retained exact original dataset JPEG payloads and filenames.

source_pose_evidence.caution: Supplied pose metadata was parsed, not re-estimated. Distinct poses support different viewpoints; no SfM registration success is claimed. Pose rows are not mapped to filenames without additionally verifying source loader conventions.

verification.jpeg_dimensions_method: JPEG SOF header parsing; no resizing or re-encoding
verification.perceptual_deduplication: not_performed; SHA256 uniqueness and supplied pose uniqueness are separate evidence
verification.formal_32_gib_acceptance: pending; preparation is not a reconstruction, live-preview, resource or performance result
